Package pt.pa.model

Class TransportMetrics

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.model.TransportMetrics
public class TransportMetrics extends Object
Represents the transport metrics of a transport mode. Each transport metric includes a distance, duration and cost.

    • getCheapestCost

      public double getCheapestCost()
      Retrieves the cheapest cost among the distance, duration, and cost attributes. This method compares the values of distance, duration, and cost, sorts them in ascending order, and returns the smallest value as the cheapest cost.

      The costs are assumed to be stored as the `distance`, `duration`, and `cost` instance variables of the object. The method is useful for determining the lowest cost option based on these three criteria.

      Returns:
      The smallest of the three costs (distance, duration, and cost).
